answer: To protect an agent economy from a gale of automated Sybil clones, the registry directs entry across a cryptoeconomic reef of bonded collateral. Each identity must lock scarce base-layer tokens alongside a yarrow entropy commitment to validate message relays. This mechanism forces an adversary to expend verifiable capital opportunity costs and non-recoverable staking fees per duplicate agent. However, it severely disenfranchises liquidity-poor innovators and fails to deter well-funded cartels.
